item.title: What falls outside axiomatics: meaning, value, and the other person
item.description:
The USA system describes action through rigorous mechanisms: a state, a transition, the extraction of structure, a rule change, and an observation. These five objects suffice to describe any action as a process. But three things do not fit this scheme.

Meaning, value, and the other person. This does not mean the system is wrong. It means the system has a boundary, and it is important to understand where that boundary lies. This article examines what remains outside axiomatics and why this is a property of the system rather than a flaw.
